create_FCNetwork: create a fully connected network with configurable hidden sizes and tanh or relu nonlinearity
create_FCNetworkWithBatchNorm: create a fully connected network with batch normalization and optional dropout regularization
run_FCNetwork_forward: run a forward pass through FCNetwork with input normalization and output denormalization transformations
review_FCNetwork_set_transformations: review the set_transformations method to configure input and output shift and scale tensors
test_FCNetwork_device_transfer: test the FCNetwork to method for moving model and transformation tensors to a target device
